right.sentence: Harbourline employed 1,840 drivers at the end of 2025.
An average delivery took 2.4 days in 2025.
The fleet covered 96 million kilometres in 2025.
Carbon emissions per tonne fell 11% in 2025.

right.why: The Harbourline Logistics annual review 2025 says the board proposes a final dividend of 6.5p per share, which matches the sentence, though the sentence states it as settled while the Document describes it as a proposal.
